+def _print_trusted_host(source):
+    """Print ``--trusted-host`` for a source with ``verify_ssl = false``.
+
+    ``pipenv install`` passes it to pip for such sources, so the requirements
+    file needs it as well for ``pip install -r`` to accept the index.
+    """
+    try:
+        trusted_host = trusted_host_for_source(
+            _brace_env_vars(source.get("url", "")),
+            source.get("verify_ssl", True),
+        )
+    except Exception:
+        return
+    if trusted_host:
+        print(f"--trusted-host {trusted_host}")

+def trusted_host_for_source(url, verify_ssl):
+    """Return the ``--trusted-host`` value for a source, or ``None``.
+
+    ``--trusted-host`` is a hostname allowlist; it's meaningless for a
+    hostless URL (file:// has no host to trust or distrust) and pip's own
+    source-is-verified bookkeeping (verify_ssl) has no way to express "not
+    applicable" - it's a plain bool (see
+    plette.models.sources.Source.__SCHEMA__). Skipping on a missing host
+    avoids emitting the nonsensical literal "--trusted-host None" regardless
+    of what verify_ssl says.
+    """
+    if verify_ssl:
+        return None
+    url_parts = parse_url(url)
+    host = url_parts.host
+    if not host:
+        return None
+    if "$" in host:
+        # parse_url lowercases the host, which breaks a ${ENV_VAR} placeholder.
+        authority = url.partition("//")[2].partition("/")[0]
+        start = authority.lower().rfind(host)
+        if start != -1:
+            host = authority[start : start + len(host)]
+    port = f":{url_parts.port}" if url_parts.port else ""
+    return f"{host}{port}"
+

@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+"""``pipenv requirements`` emits ``--trusted-host`` for sources with ``verify_ssl = false``."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+SOURCES = [
+    {"url": "https://pypi.org/simple", "name": "pypi", "verify_ssl": True},
+    {"url": "https://user:${TOKEN}@private.example:8443/simple", "name": "private", "verify_ssl": False},
+    {"url": "https://other.example/simple", "name": "other", "verify_ssl": False},
+    {"url": "https://${PRIVATE_HOST}/simple", "name": "env-host", "verify_ssl": False},
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("no_lock", [False, True])
+def test_requirements_trusted_host(tmp_path, no_lock):
+    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    pipfile = (
+        "\n".join(
+            f'[[source]]\nurl = "{s["url"]}"\nname = "{s["name"]}"\nverify_ssl = {str(s["verify_ssl"]).lower()}\n'
+            for s in SOURCES
+        )
+        + '\n[packages]\nexample = "==1.2.3"\n'
+    )
+    lock = json.dumps(
+        {
+            "_meta": {"sources": SOURCES, "hash": {"sha256": "0" * 64}, "pipfile-spec": 6},
+            "default": {"example": {"version": "==1.2.3"}},
+            "develop": {},
+        }
+    )
+    (tmp_path / "Pipfile").write_text(pipfile)
+    (tmp_path / "Pipfile.lock").write_text(lock)
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(source), PIPENV_PIPFILE=str(tmp_path / "Pipfile"), PIPENV_IGNORE_VIRTUALENVS="1", PIPENV_DONT_LOAD_ENV="1")
+    args = [sys.executable, "-m", "pipenv", "requirements"]
+    if no_lock:
+        args.append("--no-lock")
+    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=tmp_path, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+    assert result.stdout.splitlines() == [
+        "-i https://pypi.org/simple",
+        "--extra-index-url https://user:${TOKEN}@private.example:8443/simple",
+        "--trusted-host private.example:8443",
+        "--extra-index-url https://other.example/simple",
+        "--trusted-host other.example",
+        "--extra-index-url https://${PRIVATE_HOST}/simple",
+        "--trusted-host ${PRIVATE_HOST}",
+        "example==1.2.3",
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("url", "verify_ssl", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("https://Example.com:8443/simple", False, "example.com:8443"),
+        ("https://${PRIVATE_HOST}/simple", False, "${PRIVATE_HOST}"),
+        ("https://user:pw@${PRIVATE_HOST}:8443/simple", False, "${PRIVATE_HOST}:8443"),
+        ("https://example.com/simple", True, None),
+        ("file:///tmp/simple", False, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_trusted_host_for_source(url, verify_ssl, expected):
+    from pipenv.utils.indexes import trusted_host_for_source
+
+    assert trusted_host_for_source(url, verify_ssl) == expected
